purpose: Define the evidence and conservation boundary required before a national capability can become executable simulation state.
counting_rule: Each physical item or explicitly aggregated cohort belongs to exactly one mutually exclusive state bucket at a time.
simulation_ready_gates: The accounting boundary and counting unit are explicit.
Opening quantity equals the sum of mutually exclusive opening state buckets, or the unresolved difference is represented as disputed or unknown.
Every quantity and readiness assertion traces to accepted atomic claims.
No crisis roster duplicates an item already present in the national pool.
Required support dependencies are represented and finite.
Allocation consumes availability and creates an auditable release path.
Political authority, operational tasking, and physical availability are separate gates.
Location precision never exceeds the supporting public evidence.
forbidden_shortcuts: A theater order may not create national inventory.
A named weapon may not imply an available delivery platform.
A delivery platform may not imply compatible munitions, crews, sensors, access, or authority.
Alliance membership may not imply participation or access.
Missing evidence may not be converted to zero.
A post action assessment may not destroy, restore, or move ground truth by itself.
A confidence score may not substitute for a physical state transition.
